hours._todo: Only the OPENING time is still unconfirmed. Once known, set open_time_verified:true and complete the openingHours in the JSON-LD (currently emitted as Mo,Tu,Th,Fr,Sa,Su with a close of 21:00 and no opens value).

price_range._source: Wongnai listing price band, per head

reservations._note: No booking system, booking link or reservation statement exists on any of their channels. The site therefore offers CALL / MESSAGE only and does NOT render a fake booking form.

pets._note: The brief described an air-conditioned pet-friendly area sourced from customer reports. Nothing on the restaurant Instagram, Facebook About, Facebook posts, Wongnai listing or any search result confirms a pet policy. NO POLICY IS PUBLISHED. The site renders an honest ask-first module instead.
pets._when_confirmed: Set verified:true, then fill: species, size limits, indoor/outdoor zones, air-conditioned area yes/no, leash rule, booking requirement.
